title: History 1149: Bug 1921394 - Sort folders as they are read in from the database. r=BenC,aleca A folder in the database can either have an ordinal value or null. Folders with ordinals are sorted first, in ascending order, then folders without ordinals in alphabetical order. The order of those with null will be further refined in a later patch, as it needs to account for non-ASCII characters and the ordering of special folder types.
